Ranking is unstable and several models have correlated errors; a robust weighted combination using inverse error may improve over mean.
Seasonal strength moderate and ranking unstable suggests trimming outliers may help; try trimmed_mean on full pool.
I will test a weighted combination using softmax_neg_error weights to see if a more aggressive weighting improves over the trimmed mean, given the noisy, moderately seasonal series.
The series has unstable ranking (tau 0.103) and moderate seasonality; a robust DBA approach may outperform simple mean/trimmed.
The series has unstable ranking and several correlated groups; a forward‑selection based weighting may capture complementary models better than simple weighted.
The series has unstable ranking and moderate seasonality; a robust median combination may outperform mean/trimmed.
test a weighted combination on the stable pool (trend 0, unstable ranking) to see if focusing on the 5 most stable models improves SMAPE.

The series has unstable ranking and moderate seasonality; a robust weighted combination over a stable subset (pool1) with softmax weighting may better capture complementary strengths without overfitting to a few models.
The series has unstable ranking and moderate seasonality; a robust median on the already‑selected pool1 may improve robustness.
The series shows unstable ranking and moderate seasonality; a robust DBA on the top‑5 pool may outperform the current median.
test a simple mean combination on the small robust pool (trend absent, moderate seasonality, unstable ranking) to see if averaging the top 5 reduces variance.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool1' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8906. Series context: trend strength 0.0 and seasonal strength 0.425; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.103); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.453.
